reel.hook: Germans don’t freak out — they do THIS 🐷

caption:
In Germany, we don’t say "I can’t believe it!" — we say „ich glaub, mein Schwein pfeift“ (literally „I think my pig is whistling“ 🐷). Yes, that’s really how we freak out. 😄
